query: Write app/dashboard/error.tsx for a Next.js 16.2 App Router segment whose Server Component failed while fetching dashboard data. It should report the unexpected error once and offer a retry that refetches the RSC data.
baseline_failure: Agent copies an older App Router example and uses reset, which rerenders the boundary without refreshing the failed RSC data.
expected_behavior: Declares error.tsx as a Client Component
Accepts error and unstable_retry with the installed Next.js 16.2 ErrorInfo signature
Reports the unexpected error once and calls unstable_retry from the retry button
anti_expectation: Does NOT use reset alone for a retry that must refetch failed RSC data
Does NOT report the same error in both the boundary and another RSC capture owner

baseline_observed.method: Fresh Codex CLI sessions in an empty directory with fresh HOME/CODEX_HOME; gpt-5.6-luna; no installed skills for RED, then only current SKILL.md and loading-and-errors.md for GREEN.
baseline_observed.verdict: RED reproduced: the no-skill response used reset even though recovery had to refetch failed RSC data.

green_check.note: With no ambient skills, the referenced guidance changed the same response to unstable_retry while retaining one boundary-owned report and a retry button.
